course_name: 經營模式與智慧化企業
outline:
在全球化競爭加劇與科技創新加速的時代，企業經營模式正面臨前所未有的挑戰與轉型契機。工業 4.0、數位轉型、人工智慧驅動、平台經濟與 ESG 永續等議題交織，使企業不僅需要重新思考如何創造、傳遞與獲取價值，更必須在產業鏈與生態系快速重塑的過程中，找到新的競爭優勢。本課程專為企業主與高階主管設計，從企業、產業到國家三個層次切入，透過宏觀視角剖析全球產業趨勢與經營模式的演進，同時結合理論解析與實務個案，協助學員培養跨域思維與策略決策能力。
課程內容以「經營模式創新」與「智慧化企業」為核心，涵蓋創新管理、開放式創新、破壞式創新、雙軌轉型、AI 驅動商業模式、地緣政治與產業鏈重組等議題，並邀請產業專家與企業高層進行專題演講，搭配實務案例與小組研討，帶領學員理解企業在高度不確定環境中如何進行組織轉型與策略布局。透過課堂互動與跨產業觀點交流，學員將能掌握智慧化企業的核心能力，強化決策高度與前瞻視野，並在面對數位科技、產業生態與全球競合的劇烈變革時，為企業找到持續成長與創新的動能。

In an era of intensifying global competition and accelerating technological innovation, businesses are facing unprecedented challenges as well as new opportunities for transformation. The convergence of Industry 4.0, digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI), platform economies, and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) imperatives is compelling firms not only to rethink how they create, deliver, and capture value, but also to identify new sources of competitive advantage as industry value chains and business ecosystems undergo rapid restructuring.

Designed specifically for business owners and senior executives, this course examines these transformations from three interconnected levels: the firm, industry, and national levels. Adopting a macro and strategic perspective, the course explores emerging global industry trends and the evolution of business models while integrating theoretical frameworks with real-world business cases. Through this approach, participants will develop cross-disciplinary perspectives and strengthen their strategic decision-making capabilities in increasingly complex and uncertain business environments.

The course centers on two key themes: Business Model Innovation and the Intelligent Enterprise. Major topics include innovation management, open innovation, disruptive innovation, dual transformation, AI-driven business models, geopolitics, and global value chain restructuring. Industry experts and senior executives will also be invited to share their practical insights and experiences. These sessions, together with business cases and group discussions, will enable participants to examine how firms undertake organizational transformation and formulate strategic responses under conditions of heightened uncertainty.

Through interactive discussions and cross-industry knowledge exchange, participants will develop a deeper understanding of the core capabilities required to build and manage intelligent enterprises. Ultimately, the course aims to enhance participants’ strategic perspective and foresight, enabling them to identify new sources of sustainable growth and innovation amid profound changes in digital technologies, industrial ecosystems, and global competition and collaboration.
